boundary: Trails are bounded candidate searches generated from the formation signature. A trail match licenses the same bounded public-record questions elsewhere; it never asserts coordination, wrongdoing, or geomancy, and it can only ever promote candidates for separate human review.
terminal_note: The transcript-recovery trail is terminal: the artifact is unavailable in every store reachable from this environment, and the relayed inventory stands as the preserved record. Seven trails closed this increment (deed chronology, DAIA formation, Wahl title, station cost share, and the three comparable-corridor trails); three new bounded trails opened from what they surfaced (the 2024 grantor identity, the Town Center owner entities, and the Monrovia BID's enabling ordinance).
